**Description**

According the log of running any ansible playbook test case, it appears that each task reads 'vars/docker_registry.yml' defined in ansible/test_sonic.yml:

```
TASK [test : set_fact] *********************************************************
task path: /root/mars/workspace/sonic-mgmt/ansible/roles/test/tasks/interface.yml:17
Thursday 02 January 2020  <IPV6> +0000 (<IPV6>.756)       <IPV6>.008 ******
skipping: [dut-switch-t1-lag] => {
    "changed": false,
    "skip_reason": "Conditional result was False"
}
Read vars_file 'vars/docker_registry.yml'

TASK [test : include_tasks] ****************************************************
task path: /root/mars/workspace/sonic-mgmt/ansible/roles/test/tasks/interface.yml:19
Thursday 02 January 2020  <IPV6> +0000 (<IPV6>.645)       <IPV6>.654 ******
skipping: [dut-switch-t1-lag] => (item=Ethernet16)  => {
    "ansible_loop_var": "item",
    "changed": false,
    "item": "Ethernet16",
    "skip_reason": "Conditional result was False"
}
Read vars_file 'vars/docker_registry.yml'

TASK [test : pause and wait interface to be up] ********************************
task path: /root/mars/workspace/sonic-mgmt/ansible/roles/test/tasks/interface.yml:22
Thursday 02 January 2020  <IPV6> +0000 (<IPV6>.674)       <IPV6>.328 ******
skipping: [dut-switch-t1-lag] => {
    "changed": false,
    "skip_reason": "Conditional result was False"
}
Read vars_file 'vars/docker_registry.yml'
```

Reference to the "vars/docker_registry.yml" file is in ansible/test_sonic.yml:
```
- hosts: sonic
  vars_files:
    - vars/docker_registry.yml
  roles:
    - { role: test, scope: 'sonic' }
```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run any ansible-playbook test case.
2. Observe the ansible playbook log
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
Each task logs `Read vars_file 'vars/docker_registry.yml'`

**Describe the results you expected:**
It would be better to read the var file once rather than in each task.

resolution.title: Fix the issue of reading vars_file 'vars/docker_registry.yml' for each task
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #1307

According to log of ansible playbook test cases, each task reads vars_file 'vars/docker_registry.yml'.
This PR fix this issue.

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### How did you do it?
* Remove the 'vars_files' statement in test_sonic.yml
* Read the vars using include_vars in sonic.yml

#### How did you verify/test it?
Test run a few ansible playbook cases.
